name: neevcloud
description: NeevCloud agent skills for building on sandboxes.

plugins.name: neevcloud
plugins.description: NeevCloud agent skills bundle: the SDK skill for creating sandboxes, running code and processes, and exposing a port to get a public preview URL, the CLI skill for signing in, choosing an organization and project, and managing sandboxes from the command line, and the sandbox MCP skill for connecting an agent to a sandbox as native tools.
